search_strategy: The agent dumped entire Mattermost channels to /tmp/mm/world__<channel>.txt (all 6 channels visible: code-review, engineering, pipeline, cookbooks, releases, viewer) and then grepped those local dumps repeatedly for topic keywords (window_start, supervised_tokens, EncodingReport, last_report, dropped_indices, marker/truncated, etc.), which is how it caught both members of each r1 herring/reversal pair in single wide grep passes (e.g. line 3527-3553). For wiki, it similarly bulk-dumped all 239 pages with comments to /tmp/wj/<id>.json+.txt (line 1552-1883), but then read individual pages by title relevance (132, 137, 142, 144, 145, 153, 155, 156, plus several others found later) rather than grepping the full local dump for every topic; a title-relevance selection is exactly why docs/engineering/request-builder-what-we-drop-and-what-we-raise-on.md (page 149) was fetched into the dump but never opened -- its title gives no clue that it holds the correction for the mail-thread herring the agent had already accepted as settled. For mail, it read via Roundcube/IMAP and covered essentially every one of the 13 mail-carried remarks (all found). Overall coverage: mail 13/13, chat ~22/29 (7 misses, all redundant with other found remarks for the same fact), wiki comments 8/15 (7 misses, of which one pair -- g9.r2.l17/g9.r2.rev3 on page 149 -- was load-bearing for the lost fact).
end_reason: Not applicable -- the run completed normally: code was pushed, CI went green, and deploy/provenance all passed (provenance.pushed=1, provenance.ci_green=1, provenance.deployed=1). Only one hidden fact (g9.r2.failure_behavior) scored 0; everything else, including open_feature (weight 0) and suite_ok, passed.
notable: Root cause of the only lost fact: format_batch's except clause at transcript line 7314 catches (InvalidRoleSequenceError, ExampleTooLongError) together, when only ExampleTooLongError should be absorbed as a row-level drop; InvalidRoleSequenceError should propagate and abort the pass.

This traces to a herring (g9.r2.h-role-row, line 5672) the agent found and believed, and whose sole reversal (g9.r2.rev3, plus its companion clue g9.r2.l17) sits as comments on wiki page docs/engineering/request-builder-what-we-drop-and-what-we-raise-on.md -- a page the agent fetched into its local dump (/tmp/wj) at line ~1552-1883 but never actually opened or grepped for after 'settling' the question from mail (line 1373 is the only appearance of this page anywhere in the transcript).

The agent's own 138-test local suite never exercised format_batch with a mixed batch containing both a good example and an invalid-role-sequence example, so the herring-driven bug shipped without any self-caught signal.

For g9.r1.say24 (scope), the wiki page BODY of docs/engineering/local-offline-inference-what-the-encode-step-returns-when-no-tokenizer-is-loaded.md independently restates the fact ('0 through 8 for the Hello pair ... model_input is the first eight of them', line 1901) in near-identical wording to the answer-key's quoted COMMENT, which the agent never printed; the fact was still covered, just via a different carrier than the one named in the key.

Both r1 herring/reversal pairs and both original r2 tuple-return herring/reversal pairs were caught correctly because the agent's broad channel-wide greps happened to return both the herring and its reversal in the same output block (lines 3527-3553, 3702-3851), letting it read the full arc in one pass -- the one herring it got wrong (h-role-row) is precisely the one whose reversal lived outside chat, in an unopened wiki comment.
